endings.name: The Charter
endings.summary: The final match is signed at 4-4. Alexi and the princess write terms between a god and the people who sail: lanes kept calm, wild water left wild. The toll is read on the terms' last page.

endings.name: No Lord
endings.summary: Alexi beats the Lord of Tea and gives up the sea, which was not meant to be owned by anyone. He becomes a mortal sailor; the Company's charters and its lights fall.

endings.name: The Wild Sea
endings.summary: Alexi beats the Lord of Tea and keeps the sea. He is the god again; the hymns come back, and so do the wrecks. The princess leaves the boat.

endings.name: The Lord's Peace
endings.summary: The Lord of Tea owns every ship that sails. The sea is safe, and Alexi is a man on an old boat whose tide no longer answers.
